sources.name: Open Library API index
notes: Open Library provides JSON, YAML, and RDF/XML APIs for public-good book discovery and lookup services.
Usage guidance says the APIs are for low-volume, high-value real-time discovery, not a bulk data backend.
Default non-identified requests are documented at 1 request per second; identified requests with User-Agent and email are documented at 3 requests per second.

sources.name: Open Library Search API
notes: The endpoint supports q, fields, sort, lang, offset, page, and limit.
Pagination is available through page/limit or offset/limit.

sources.name: Open Library Books API
notes: The docs describe Book Search as the preferred general book lookup API.
Works and editions can be fetched as JSON by adding .json to /works/<id> and /books/<id>.

sources.name: Open Library Authors API
notes: Individual authors can be fetched through /authors/<id>.json.
Author works are available through /authors/<id>/works.json with limit and offset.

sources.name: Open Library Subjects API
notes: details=true returns additional related subjects, authors, publishers, and publishing history.
The page documents the Subjects API as experimental.

non_goals: bulk harvesting or local mirror sync
